description: This Java class 'JsonExamplesProducer' generates JSON example files for different exceptions and error scenarios, mainly used for testing or documentation purposes within the Eclipse Ditto project. It produces JSON representations of various predefined exception objects related to gateway and JSON parsing errors.

classes.name: JsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class that generates example JSON files representing various exceptions for testing or documentation purposes within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initiates the JSON generation process, accepting a directory path as argument.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the produce method with the given arguments and producer instance.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Creates specific directories and files containing JSON representations of exceptions.

methods.name: produceGatewayExceptions
methods.description: Generates JSON files for gateway-related exceptions.

methods.name: produceJsonExceptions
methods.description: Generates JSON files for JSON parsing and field-related exceptions.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable object to a JSON string and writes it to a specified file.
